mina (People Ops): Quick ask  were planning a 'Micro-Spot' recognition week (small awards + coffee cards) for folks who got kudos this quarter. Looking for volunteers to coordinate pickup, a legal check for wording, and a facilities drop window.

 anya (Sales): Love it. Coffee cards + sticker = easy win. How many recipients?

 people-bot: Export: 46 recipients in scope. 6 are remote. Link: https://go.example.com/micro-spot-export

 tara (Design): I can print 50 mini-cards and 60 sticker sheets. Need approvals on the wording for the card. Drafts in #people-ops-assets.

 jamal (Legal): Quick note: avoid language implying guaranteed future compensation. Suggested phrase: "Thank you for your impact this quarter". Also ensure opt-in for photos.

 mina (People Ops): Good call. We'll use Jamal's phrase. For photos, we'll ask recipients when we hand over the card.

 leo (Facilities): I can hold a midday pick-up station Mon-Wed in Mailroom B 11:30-1:30. Anyone packing needs to pick up boxes by 10am Monday.

 anya (Sales): Can Recruiting help with handoff for new hires? Some recipients start next week.

 mina (People Ops): Yes, Recruiting can coordinate for new hires; send me the list. For remote folks we'll mail a small kit (card + sticker). Shipping estimate per remote ~ $7.

 people-bot: Remote count: 6. Estimated added shipping = $42.

 tara (Design): Uploaded final art. Using teal pin accent.

 mina (People Ops): Budget approved up to $700. Please keep receipts under code PEOPLE-MICRO.

 jamal (Legal): Confirmed wording approved. Also flag: if any award >$600 escalate to payroll.

 mina (People Ops): Action items: 1) Leo reserve Mailroom B pick-up signage + table (today). 2) Tara print assets (by Fri). 3) People Ops to create a one-line script for volunteers to collect photo consent. 4) People-bot to re-export final list Mon AM.

 people-bot: Reminder set for re-export -> 2026-04-13T09:00:00-07:00

 anya (Sales): Volunteers: I can take Mon 11:30-12:30, plus two folks from sales.

 leo (Facilities): Table reserved. Ill bring dolly and tape.

 mina (People Ops): Thanks all  will post final volunteer schedule Mon AM and close this thread. :bouquet:
